digest.component_or_area: tickets repository store migration and epoch guard deployment
propositions: Execute a one-time irreversible force-push to rewrite git history on the tickets repository after confirming all writers are quiesced, all sessions stopped, and all MCP servers halted.
Validate epoch-mismatch refusal for the deployed review-bot runtime and the explicitly refreshed host binary before publication to prevent stale-writer acceptance.
Verify that the fresh unfiltered clone after rewrite is ≤150 MiB and contains an identical tree hash, with commit/merge counts unchanged from the pre-rewrite baseline.

Land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit with the mapped post-rewrite SHA, requiring the review-bot's first deterministic post-window vote to be recorded with old-tip ancestry assertion and <1 MB size-pack growth.

After re-enabling workflows and services, validate post-window reconciliation via green reconcile-bridge.yml run or operator-approved signed CLI sequence with zero Jira batch errors and canary drift_total=0, followed by final fsck confirming zero repairable findings and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records.

Confirm via fresh unfiltered clone that the old tip is not an ancestor of any default-fetched ref and does not exist in the published repository, proving irreversible non-resurrection after the force-push.
